name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
label: Quest
description: Fight for Warsong Gulch: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Don't forget the fight for Warsong Gulch is about more than just protecting trees. It's about keeping a natural barrier between Ashenvale and the Barrens. Do you bring any news from the battlefield, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good work, friend. Thanks to you, our natural defenses in Ashenvale will remain intact for another day.
